about: Layering fixtures, run by tools/ci/test-hygiene.ps1. Each case copies the files gen-project-graph.ps1 reads (docs/project-graph.json, Directory.Packages.props, every registered fsproj and .lrm.targets, and the generated outputs) plus the root Directory.Build.props/targets and build/*.props into a temporary root, applies its edits, and runs the layering check there: the generator and the MSBuild extension scan. edits: addRef / addBuildRef (project, ref), addPackage (project, package), addProject (project object). files: path -> content, written over the copy. The unmodified copy must pass first.

cases.name: unmodified-copy
cases.why: positive control: the copy of the real graph passes, so every failure below comes from its edit

cases.name: handwritten-project-reference
cases.why: acceptance: a bad ProjectReference written into an fsproj fails; references come only from the graph

cases.name: handwritten-property-group
cases.why: an fsproj holds file items only; build logic goes in <Name>.lrm.targets

cases.name: model-reaches-gpu
cases.why: Models.Qwen never references a GPU project

cases.name: cluster-reaches-gpu-transitively
cases.why: the rules hold on the transitive closure: Cluster -> Tensor -> Gpu.Core is caught

cases.name: core-references-something
cases.why: Core references nothing

cases.name: exec-reaches-backend
cases.why: Gpu.Exec never references a concrete backend or CpuDevice

cases.name: lib-wires-backend
cases.why: only apps and tests wire backends

cases.name: interop-outside-backend
cases.why: an interop project is used only by its own backend, apps and tests

cases.name: reference-to-exe
cases.why: nothing references an app, a test exe or a tool
match: ^rule no-refs-to-executables: Lrm\.Reports -> Lrm\.Cli references a app

cases.name: extra-build-only-edge
cases.why: Shaders -> Shaders.Build is the only build-only edge
match: ^rule build-only-edges: Lrm\.Gpu\.Core -> Lrm\.Shaders\.Build is not an allowed build-only edge$

cases.name: cycle
cases.why: the graph is acyclic

cases.name: unregistered-fsproj
cases.why: every fsproj outside spikes/ is registered in the graph

cases.name: spike-in-graph
cases.why: spikes/** is never in the graph or the solution

cases.name: unpinned-package
cases.why: a project names only packages from the graph's list, each pinned in Directory.Packages.props
match: ^Lrm\.Tokenizer: package 'Newtonsoft\.Json' is not in the top-level packages list$

cases.name: stale-generated-props
cases.why: an allowed edge that was not regenerated fails the codegen diff

cases.name: lrm-targets-switches-off-guard
cases.why: a .lrm.targets cannot mark its project a spike, unlock the restore or add a reference (the evasion of the S0b review)
match: ^src/Lrm\.Tokenizer/Lrm\.Tokenizer\.lrm\.targets: sets the property LrmIsSpike, which the root build files own
^src/Lrm\.Tokenizer/Lrm\.Tokenizer\.lrm\.targets: <ProjectReference> is a reference item; references come only from docs/project-graph\.json

cases.name: lrm-targets-case-variants
cases.why: MSBuild property and item names ignore case, and so does the scan

cases.name: lrm-targets-task-output
cases.why: a target that adds a reference through a task Output is caught like an item element

files.src/Lrm.Tokenizer/Lrm.Tokenizer.lrm.targ:
<Project>
  <Target Name="Sneak" BeforeTargets="ResolveProjectReferences">
    <CreateItem Include="../Lrm.Gpu.D3D12/Lrm.Gpu.D3D12.fsproj" AdditionalMetadata="LrmGraph=true">
      <Output TaskParameter="Include" ItemName="ProjectReference" />
    </CreateItem>
    <CreateProperty Value="false">
      <Output TaskParameter="Value" PropertyName="RestoreLockedMode" />
    </CreateProperty>
  </Target>
</Project>

match: a task Output adds the reference item ProjectReference
a task Output sets the property RestoreLockedMode

cases.name: lrm-targets-guard-items
cases.why: a target that empties the guard's snapshot (_LrmHand*) or adds analyzers is caught

files.src/Lrm.Tokenizer/Lrm.Tokenizer.lrm.targ:
<Project>
  <Target Name="Sneak" BeforeTargets="LrmCheckProjectGraph">
    <ItemGroup>
      <_LrmHandProjectReference Remove="@(_LrmHandProjectReference)" />
      <Analyzer Include="x.dll" />
      <PackageDownload Include="X" Version="[1.0.0]" />
    </ItemGroup>
  </Target>
</Project>

cases.name: lrm-targets-import
cases.why: a .lrm.targets imports nothing, so no MSBuild code escapes the scan
match: ^src/Lrm\.Tokenizer/Lrm\.Tokenizer\.lrm\.targets: <Import> is not allowed; a \.lrm\.targets file imports nothing

cases.name: lrm-targets-root-properties
cases.why: a .lrm.targets never overrides a property the root build files set (warnings as errors, the DXC pin)

cases.name: lrm-targets-sdk-attribute
cases.why: a .lrm.targets cannot pull in an SDK or shield properties from the command line

cases.name: compile-outside-project
cases.why: a Compile item, in the fsproj or its .lrm.targets, names only files inside its own project; code from another project comes through a reference

cases.name: nested-directory-build-targets
cases.why: a nested Directory.Build.targets replaces the root one for its subtree (the second evasion of the S0b review)
match: ^src/Lrm\.Tokenizer/Directory\.Build\.targets: a nested Directory\.Build\.targets replaces the root one for everything below src/Lrm\.Tokenizer/

cases.name: nested-props-and-packages
cases.why: nested Directory.Build.props, Directory.Packages.props, NuGet.Config and global.json are refused, whatever their case

cases.name: response-and-user-files
cases.why: Directory.Build.rsp adds command-line switches and <proj>.user is imported into the project; neither is allowed

cases.name: lrm-targets-allowed
cases.why: positive control: R4a's shader target (its own Lrm* properties and items, a task reading ProjectReference, EmbeddedResource) and R3's Tailcalls switch pass

files.src/Lrm.Shaders/Lrm.Shaders.lrm.targets:
<Project>
  <ItemGroup>
    <LrmShaderInput Include="$(MSBuildThisFileDirectory)hlsl/**/*.hlsl" />
    <LrmShaderInput Include="$(LrmRepoRoot)src/Lrm.Gpu.Core/Catalog/catalog.json" />
  </ItemGroup>
  <Target Name="LrmResolveShaderTool" DependsOnTargets="ResolveProjectReferences">
    <MSBuild Projects="@(ProjectReference)" Condition="'%(ProjectReference.LrmBuildOnly)' == 'true'" Targets="GetTargetPath">
      <Output TaskParameter="TargetOutputs" PropertyName="LrmShadersBuildDll" />
    </MSBuild>
    <PropertyGroup>
      <LrmShadersOut>$(IntermediateOutputPath)shaders</LrmShadersOut>
      <LrmDotnet>$(DOTNET_HOST_PATH)</LrmDotnet>
      <LrmDxcStamp>$(LrmShadersOut)/dxc.stamp</LrmDxcStamp>
    </PropertyGroup>
  </Target>
  <Target Name="LrmCompileShaders" DependsOnTargets="LrmResolveShaderTool" BeforeTargets="PrepareResourceNames" Condition="'$(LrmIsSpike)' != 'true'">
    <Exec Command=""$(LrmDotnet)" "$(LrmShadersBuildDll)" compile" />
    <ItemGroup>
      <_LrmShaderFile Include="$(LrmShadersOut)/dxil/*.dxil" LrmPrefix="lrm.shaders/dxil/" />
      <EmbeddedResource Include="@(_LrmShaderFile)" LogicalName="%(_LrmShaderFile.LrmPrefix)%(_LrmShaderFile.Filename)%(_LrmShaderFile.Extension)" />
      <FileWrites Include="$(LrmShadersOut)/**/*" />
    </ItemGroup>
  </Target>
</Project>

cases.name: spikes-are-free
cases.why: positive control: spikes/** is outside the graph, so its build files are not scanned
